caption: The flow applies the same scores as the worked example: good +2 becomes -2 after not, excellent +3, total +1. Notice that the aspect panel keeps film and songs separate.

spec.title: Lexicon sentiment pipeline
spec.aria: A rightward flow starts with tokens not, good and excellent, applies lexicon scores, flips good after not, sums to +1, and splits aspects into film negative and songs positive.
